headline: Profit climbs to cap the year; bullish outlook issued
summary_short: PFG's fiscal fourth-quarter net sales rose 6.4% y/y to $18.03B and net income jumped 23.4% to $162.3M, with GAAP diluted EPS up 22.6% to $1.03 and Adjusted Diluted EPS up 2.6% to $1.59.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 2026 net sales grew 6.4% y/y to $18.03B on higher selling prices (~4.7% cost inflation), organic case growth, and acquisitions. Gross profit rose 8.3% to $2.17B on favorable channel mix and vendor rebates. Net income rose 23.4% to $162.3M; GAAP diluted EPS rose 22.6% to $1.03 while Adjusted Diluted EPS rose 2.6% to $1.59. Adjusted EBITDA rose 7.4% to $587.5M, with Convenience (+10.4%) and Foodservice (+2.2%) growing and Specialty (-0.5%) flat. Full fiscal 2026 operating cash flow was $1.41B and free cash flow $1.03B (+46.2% y/y) on lower capex. PFG initiated FY2027 guidance: full-year net sales $72.5-73B, Adjusted EBITDA $2.125-2.225B (includes a 53rd week); Q1 FY2027 net sales $17.9-18.1B, Adjusted EBITDA $510-530M.

drivers.explanation: CEO Scott McPherson: "Our solid execution throughout the year produced a strong finish to fiscal 2026" with market-share gains driving revenue growth and record Adjusted EBITDA, entering FY2027 "with significant momentum."
Company cites higher selling price per case from inflation (~4.7% product-cost inflation), an increase in organic cases sold with a favorable mix shift, and recent acquisitions.
Attributed to growth and mix of cases sold -- including growth in the higher-margin independent channel -- recent acquisitions, and vendor rebates and promotional incentives.
Driven by higher gross profit, partially offset by higher operating expenses (acquisitions, fuel, personnel, D&A) and a higher effective tax rate (26.8% vs 25.6% prior year).
Segment mix drove the gain: Convenience Adjusted EBITDA +10.4% and Foodservice +2.2% (opex growth nearly offsetting gross-profit gains), while Specialty was roughly flat at -0.5%.
Full-year operating cash flow rose on higher cash-based operating income and $52.3M of income tax refunds, partly offset by advance inventory purchases; capex fell $121.9M year-over-year.
Company refinanced: $1,060M of new Notes due 2034 funded repayment of $1,060M Notes due 2027, plus a $384M net paydown of the ABL Facility during fiscal 2026.
Not itemized by component in the release; the year-over-year increase is consistent with $359.3M of full-year net income retained, partly offset by $1.5M of share repurchases.
